replies.body:
Nice map! I can't download and go through it entirely, but it's cool from the pictures. I don't think it's best to put the monument in that room with chests though; it's too easy to get the monument through tunneling, and defending would be very easy if you think about it; a group of players can pretty much protect it by breaking a few blocks/stairs, and pushing a player that's mining the monument into a corner or something. It'd be best to make the monument in a slightly more open area.

I hope that the height limit isn't so astronomically high that skybridging will determine who wins the map.

replies.author: StaticFaultz
replies.body:
Hm. Well, actually, now that I know the actual position of the map, I suggest leaving the monuments in the same position as they are in a likeable position, but perhaps attempting to make the room bigger might help. Position it above the ship a little bit rather than a little bit below. Widening the path to the monuments by at least two blocks balances out how hard it is to get the monument and how easy it will be to defend (which is very easy for the first two monuments near the spawn).

Oh, and I'd also like to say that for a 50v50, I don't think that's enough iron. Perhaps, you can decorate the top and include some more iron!
